paper.note: Paper only — no real orders or API keys. $50 notional at 1x, 0.05% taker fee per side, fill at the confirmation candle close.

paper_unconfirmed.note: Paper only — no real orders or API keys. Default $50 notional at 1x, 0.05% taker fee per side. Enters at the close of the candle when a new unconfirmed BUY?/SELL? first appears. If that signal fades (repaints), the position stays open. A later same-direction unconfirmed signal adds another leg of the first leg's notional (up to 4 adds, 5 legs). An opposite unconfirmed signal closes the whole stack and flips.

adx.note: Same rules as the 1-minute ADX scanner (ADX ≥ 25 and rising, fresh +DI/−DI cross). Read-only; does not change the alert routine's state.
